name: Payoneer
summary: Local receiving accounts for freelancers and sellers paid by international clients and marketplaces.
best_for: freelancers and sellers getting paid by international clients and marketplaces (Amazon, Upwork, Fiverr) who need local receiving accounts
skip_if: your main need is cheap currency conversion — a specialist FX account usually beats Payoneer's conversion markup
honest_knock: The conversion and cross-currency withdrawal markups are where it quietly costs you — for pure currency conversion a specialist like Wise is often cheaper. Payoneer earns its keep on marketplace payouts and getting paid by international clients, less so as an FX tool.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-02 on payoneer.com/pricing/, where the older payoneer.com/about/pricing/ address now redirects; the page itself carries "Last updated on 1 January 2026") Free to open; the cost is in the fees. Receiving into a receiving account in your local currency is free, in a currency that is not your local currency 1% (minimum $1). Receiving by credit card or PayPal up to 3.99% + $0.49; by US ACH bank debit or an EU or UK bank account 1%. Withdrawing to a bank account in your own country and currency $1.50 flat; to a bank account in another country or currency 1.2%-4%, even when no conversion happens, and in some countries a minimum fee of up to $20 may apply. Moving funds between your own Payoneer balances 0.50%. Card purchases up to 1.8% without conversion and up to 3.5% with; cash withdrawals $3.15 / €2.50 / £1.95 / C$3.15 / ¥470 on top of that percentage; annual card fee $29.95, replacement card $12.95, additional virtual cards free. Annual account fee $29.95, charged only if less than $6,000 arrives in any 12 consecutive months and not charged in the first year on paid annual plans. Certain US customers, depending on registration date, instead pay a flat $1.50 per withdrawal or payment up to $50,000 a month and up to 0.5% above that. Businesses moving over $50K a month are pointed at a custom package. Workforce Management is a separate product line with its own price list, read on payoneer.com/workforce-management/ on 5 September 2026: Employer of Record from $199 per employee a month (110+ countries), Agent of Record from $99 per contractor a month (160+ countries), and the Contractor Management System from $19 per contractor a month, all three 'starts at' figures behind a demo and marked 'pricing may vary by country, services and engagement type'. Our partner link on this page belongs to that Workforce Management programme, so it lands on the workforce partners page rather than on the free payments account. Re-read on 2 October 2026 with every fee above unchanged. The card section now also states that card purchases are free where the merchant country matches the card's issuing country, that an ATM balance check or decline costs $1.00 / €0.80 / £0.65, and that a replacement card is $12.95 / €9.95 / £9.95.
